title: Amazon SNS Pricing: Cost Per Message (2026 Guide)
summary: Amazon SNS pricing combines per-request fees, data transfers, and regional rates that determine your actual bill. See exactly what each component costs.
body_markdown:
## Publishing to Amazon SNS from Activepieces workflows


The early warning only pays off if someone can send it. Activepieces lets a non-engineer trigger an SNS publish from a CRM, a form or a schedule, and MoneyGram, Moneypenny, Alan and FundingSocieties run it in production.


Every message is still billed by SNS at the rates above.


### What the integration does


Activepieces builds flows out of a trigger, steps and an action, drawing on 746 integrations in an MIT-licensed core, and the Amazon SNS integration supplies an action that publishes to your topic, so SMS notifications can be triggered directly from automated workflows without custom code.


The flow below was built for Discord, not SNS, but it shows the shape.


It has a trigger on the left, a configuration panel on the right with a connection and a cap on how many items each run pulls, and a router that decides which branch fires.


Swap the final Discord step for an SNS publish and you have the same structure for your alerts.


That cap matters for your invoice. A flow that publishes on every trigger sends as many messages as it's triggered, and you pay for each at its channel's rate.


Activepieces adds no SNS fees of its own, and it doesn't make SMS to an expensive country any cheaper.


Its own bill is separate: 1 credit per run however many steps the flow has, with 1,000 credits a month on the free plan and 10,000 on Plus at $20 a month.


### When it's worth using and when direct SDK calls are better


If the person who owns the trigger isn't the person who writes code, use it. That might be an account manager who wants a threshold alert from the CRM, or an ops lead who wants a scheduled usage notice.


They can change the rule without a ticket.


Direct SDK calls are better when publishing sits inside your product's hot path. They also win when you need tight control over retries and message attributes, or when volume is high enough that you want the publish logic in version-controlled code.


Treat Activepieces as a convenience for who can pull the lever, not a way to lower the cost of pulling it. Flows are unlimited on every plan, including free, so only runs move its side of the bill.
